name: Empress Teta unifies the Koros system
summary: Teta of Koros Major conquered the seven worlds of her system one by one, with Jedi Master Memit Nadill at her side and Kirrek the last to yield. The grateful system renamed its capital Empress Teta, and her carbonite fleets became a bulwark of the Republic.

name: Gav and Jori Daragon gamble on an unknown hyperspace route
summary: Deep in debt after their parents' deaths, the hyperspace explorers Gav and Jori Daragon stole their ship Starbreaker 12 back from impound and jumped blind along an uncharted route. It carried them clean out of Republic space and into the heart of the Sith Empire.

name: Death of Marka Ragnos
summary: The Dark Lord who had held the Sith together for a century died, and his funeral on Korriban turned into a duel between the expansionist Naga Sadow and the cautious Ludo Kressh. Ragnos's spirit rose to warn both of a coming turning point.

name: The Daragons arrive at Korriban
summary: Starbreaker 12 dropped out of hyperspace over Korriban in the middle of Ragnos's funeral. The Sith lords seized the two humans, and their arrival told Naga Sadow exactly what he wanted to know: there was a rich galaxy out there to conquer.

name: Naga Sadow seizes the title of Dark Lord
summary: Sadow freed the Daragons from Kressh's custody, staged a fake Republic rescue to frighten the Sith council, and had himself proclaimed Dark Lord in the panic. He took Gav Daragon as an apprentice and prepared the empire for war.

name: Battle of Khar Delba
summary: Ludo Kressh led the Sith lords loyal to him against Sadow's fortress on Khar Delba, only to find it a decoy. Sadow's hidden fleet on the moon Khar Shian struck Kressh's ships from behind and apparently destroyed his flagship.

name: Jori Daragon escapes to the Republic
summary: Sadow let Jori Daragon flee Khar Delba in Starbreaker 12 with a tracking beacon aboard. Her desperate flight home to Empress Teta showed the Sith fleet the way into the Republic.

name: The Great Hyperspace War begins
summary: Following Jori Daragon's beacon, Naga Sadow's armada jumped into the Republic along several routes at once, striking the Koros system and Coruscant simultaneously. The Republic had not known the Sith existed; the Jedi had barely a legend to go on.

name: Battle of Kirrek
summary: Massassi warriors stormed Kirrek while Sadow's illusions made their numbers seem endless. Jedi Odan-Urr and Memit Nadill held the Tetan defenders together until the illusions failed and the invaders were driven off.

name: Sith assault on Coruscant
summary: A Sith fleet and Massassi landing force struck the capital itself, aiming to cut off the Republic's head in a single blow. Empress Teta's reinforcements and Memit Nadill's Jedi met them in the streets of the city.

name: The Republic holds Coruscant
summary: When Sadow's battle meditation broke, the Massassi illusions vanished and the Republic defenders found themselves facing far fewer enemies than they had feared. The Sith assault on Coruscant collapsed, and the invasion's momentum was gone.

name: Battle of Primus Goluud
summary: Gav Daragon confronted his master at the red giant Primus Goluud and Empress Teta's fleet followed him in. Sadow fled, triggering the star's collapse to cover his escape and killing Gav in the explosion. The Republic fleet gave chase toward Sith space.

name: The Sith take Coruscant
summary: Speculative. Had Sadow's battle meditation held, the Massassi legions would have overrun the Senate district and the Republic government would have fled the capital. Tales of the Jedi shows the defence hanging on the collapse of Sadow's illusions alone.
basis: In The Fall of the Sith Empire the Coruscant defenders are losing until Gav Daragon's confrontation disrupts Sadow's battle meditation; this event is what that disruption prevented.

name: Sadow destroys Ludo Kressh at Korriban
summary: Returning in defeat, Sadow found Ludo Kressh alive and waiting with a fleet of his own. Sadow rammed Kressh's flagship with one of his own vessels, killing his rival at last, even as the Republic fleet arrived behind him.

name: Republic counter-invasion of Korriban
summary: Empress Teta's fleet fell on the exhausted Sith over Korriban and shattered what remained of their navy. Sadow escaped with a single ship into the Yavin system; the Sith Empire was left leaderless and open to the Republic's vengeance.

name: Naga Sadow flees to Yavin 4
summary: With his empire lost, Sadow took his last Massassi to the jungle moon Yavin 4. There they raised temples to him and he experimented with Sith alchemy until he sealed himself in stasis to wait for a worthy successor.

name: Collapse of the Sith Empire
summary: Supreme Chancellor Pultimo ordered the Republic fleet into Sith space to make sure the threat never returned. World after world was broken, and the two-thousand-year-old Sith Empire ceased to exist as a state, though its survivors scattered in every direction.

name: The Ritual of Nathema
summary: The Sith lord Vitiate summoned eight thousand fellow lords to his world Medriaas with a promise of salvation from the Republic, then bound them in a ritual that drained every living thing on the planet into himself. He emerged immortal; Medriaas became Nathema, a world with no Force at all.

name: Vitiate leads the Sith exodus to Dromund Kaas
summary: Gathering the Sith who had escaped the Republic's purge, Vitiate led a twenty-year flight through uncharted space to the lost colony of Dromund Kaas. He had himself crowned Sith Emperor and began rebuilding the empire in secret.

name: The Sith Empire is reborn on Dromund Kaas
summary: On Dromund Kaas the Emperor built Kaas City and a Dark Council of twelve lords to govern beneath him. For thirteen hundred years the reborn Sith Empire grew in the galaxy's north-east, unknown to the Republic, preparing its revenge.

name: Sith refugees found the Sorcerers of Tund
summary: A group of Sith purebloods fled the Republic's purge to the remote world Tund, where they abandoned the title of Sith and became a secretive order of sorcerers. Their tradition survived into the Imperial era.

name: The Massassi raise temples on Yavin 4
summary: Sadow's Massassi slaves built the Great Temple and its companions as focal points for their master's dark-side alchemy. The same temples would house Exar Kun's Brotherhood and, four thousand years later, the Rebel Alliance.

name: Naga Sadow seals himself in his tomb
summary: Having warped the Massassi into monstrous guardians, Sadow placed himself in suspended animation inside his Yavin 4 temple. His spirit lingered there for six centuries until the Jedi Freedon Nadd came looking for a teacher.

name: Odan-Urr founds the Great Jedi Library
summary: The Draethos Jedi Odan-Urr, a veteran of Kirrek, gathered every record the Jedi had into a vast library on Ossus, including captured Sith holocrons. He tended it for a thousand years until Exar Kun killed him in front of his own shelves.
